title: Global Optimization for Combinatorial Geometry Problems Revisited in the Era of LLMs
summary: Recent progress in LLM-driven algorithm discovery, exemplified by DeepMind's AlphaEvolve, has produced new best-known solutions for a range of hard geometric and combinatorial problems. This raises a natural question: to what extent can modern off-the-shelf global optimization solvers match such results when the problems are formulated directly as nonlinear optimization problems (NLPs)? We revisit a subset of problems from the AlphaEvolve benchmark suite and evaluate straightforward NLP formulations with two state-of-the-art solvers, the commercial FICO Xpress and the open-source SCIP.…
